item.title: ODU product Verlander returns to Tigers on one-year deal
item.description: The Old Dominion product has signed a one year contract to return to the Tigers for the 2026 season. ESPN reports the deal is worth $13 million.

item.title: Portsmouth pastor honored as Everyday Hero after 30 years of community service
item.description: Pastor Charles W. Beamon celebrated 30 years of community service in Portsmouth, helping hundreds with food, medical care and free mammograms.

item.title: Chesapeake's Tapp reassigned on Commanders' coaching staff
item.description: The Commanders will have a new-look coaching staff for the 2026 season. Some new names will take over key positions as Dan Quin's assistants, while others will undertake new responsibilities.
